user.title: Bosma Aegis
user.description: Sign in with a dedicated Bosma account. Lock/unlock, battery, door and activity update live. Native Bosma cloud control is included; no phone or IFTTT required.

verify.title: Verify this device
verify.description: Bosma requires a one-time verification for a new device. It just emailed a code to the address on account {account}. Enter that code to finish.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Bosma Aegis
reauth_confirm.description: Your Bosma password changed or the session expired. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your Bosma account email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bosma cloud. Please try again.
error.no_devices: Signed in, but no Bosma locks were found on this account.
error.invalid_code: That verification code was not accepted. Check the code Bosma emailed and try again.
error.code_resent: A new verification code was emailed. Enter the latest one.

abort.already_configured: This Bosma account is already set up.

control.title: Lock control
control.description: Native Bosma cloud control is the default and requires the lock gateway and internet. Choose Read only to disable commands, or IFTTT (legacy) to use your existing webhook configuration. Native failures never trigger IFTTT automatically.

ifttt.title: IFTTT (legacy)
ifttt.description: Use your existing IFTTT Webhooks key and per-lock event names. See docs/CONTROL_VIA_IFTTT.md. Native mode does not use these settings.

alerts.title: Door security alerts
alerts.description: Choose Home Assistant notifications, an existing phone/notify service, or both. Break-in alerts use Bosma impact alarms; enable break-in detection in the Bosma app. Door-ajar alerts use device alarms and a configurable open-door timer. These options do not change the lock siren or operate a lock.

error.no_alert_destination: Choose Home Assistant notifications or a phone/notify service.
error.notify_unavailable: That notification service is unavailable. Choose an available service.
